name: collapsible-module-groups
goal: Every Explorer catalog and relationship group can collapse independently with an accessible heading control, remains open by default, and preserves its cards, counts and keyboard navigation

Missing controls reproduced by focused mobile E2E before implementation. Four current browser cases pass across desktop/tablet/mobile plus desktop relation paging; 23 relevant Reports unit cases and the visual registry guard pass.
